name: Password Sign-In MFA Selection Required
summary: A user enters through password sign-in, submits valid credentials for an identity that has both TOTP and Passkey available, and is handed off to Select MFA Type before completing the second factor.
finalOutcome: The password proof is accepted, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and the user is presented with both available MFA methods.

sourceReferences.note: When both TOTP and Passkey are available, Password Sign In must hand off to a factor-selection surface rather than choosing one automatically.
New canonical destination for the both-MFA-methods password sign-in outcome.
